mentions.name: Retrotype
mentions.description: This app is a fun writing app that mimics the feel of a real typewriter, available free on iOS, iPad, and macOS via Catalyst. Additional skins, premium features, and an Android version are planned.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a fun writing app that mimics the feel of a real typewriter.

Free on iOS + iPad + macOS (Catalyst), and I'm working on adding additional skins, premium features, and Android soon! :)
